title: Apartment Movers in Newport Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Apartment movers in Newport Beach, CA: hourly crews, a COI for your leasing office, alley loading by city rules and Balboa Peninsula timing advice.
heroSubtitle: Hourly crews for Newport Beach rentals and condos, with the insurance certificate, the loading spot and the move window agreed before the truck arrives.

faq.question: Can the moving truck wait in the alley behind my Newport Beach building?
faq.answer: Only while it is being loaded or unloaded. City code bans stopping or parking in an alley for any other purpose unless the City Council has designated it for parking. We load from the alley when it is the shortest route and move the truck to a legal curb space whenever the crew has to pause.

faq.question: What will my apartment move cost if your crew comes down from Los Angeles?
faq.answer: You pay an hourly rate set by crew size and day of the week, starting at $119 an hour in cash for two movers and a truck from Monday to Thursday. Because Newport Beach lies outside our home area, the 4-hour minimum for jobs 30+ miles from the base and double drive time beyond 10 miles may apply. The coordinator checks both addresses and tells you which rules apply before you book.

faq.question: My leasing office wants a certificate of insurance. Can you provide it?
faq.answer: Yes. Send us the holder name and any wording the office requires, and we issue the certificate for $50 and send it before the move. Irvine Company communities and condo associations set their own requirements, so we work from the document they hand you.

faq.question: Is a summer Saturday a bad day to move out of a Balboa Peninsula apartment?
faq.answer: It is the hardest slot of the week. Only Newport Boulevard and Balboa Boulevard reach the peninsula, and the City describes both as often congested in summer and on weekends and holidays. Since the clock runs by the hour, a weekday morning usually costs less, and Monday to Thursday rates are lower as well.

faq.question: Can you move my apartment on the day I call?
faq.answer: Yes, if a crew is free. We work every day between 8AM and 6PM, so a same-day job has to fit inside that window, and we do not run evening moves. Call 909-443-0004 early in the day to leave the crew enough hours.

faq.question: How do I pick the best moving company for apartments in Newport Beach?
faq.answer: Ask each mover for three things before you book: a state license number, a certificate of insurance your building will accept, and a rate that shows crew size, day of the week and travel rules. Our numbers are CAL-T0192140, USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871. Our reviews stand at 4.9 on Google and 4.8 on Yelp.
